title: Stronger artificial intelligence breakthroughs hasten their own exhaustion
abstract: arXiv:2610.27296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Progress in artificial intelligence is widely assumed to scale with effort: more researchers, papers and investment should accelerate discovery. Theories of technological growth instead locate the difficulty of discovery in the space of ideas. Here we show that neither scale nor space is enough: breakthroughs depend on diverse attention, which collective concentration can deplete. Across 36 years of computer science, we analyze 7.2 million papers, 73,089 peer reviews and 3.7 million researchers and their topic shifts. The field expanded while its attention narrowed sharply after the Transformer. Over half of topic-shifting researchers moved into AI, especially mid-career ones, and reviewer confidence fell by a full point on a 5-point scale. translated_title: 更强的人工智能突破加速了其自身的枯竭
translated_abstract: 人工智能的进步通常被假定为随投入规模而扩展：更多的研究者、论文和投资应当会加速科学发现。然而，技术增长理论则将发现的困难定位于思想空间本身。我们的研究表明，无论是规模还是空间都不足以解释：突破依赖于多样化的注意力，而集体的集中会耗尽这种多样性。通过分析36年的计算机科学研究——包括720万篇论文、73,089份同行评审意见以及370万研究人员及其研究主题的转换——我们发现，该领域在不断扩张的同时，其注意力在Transformer出现后急剧收窄。超过一半转换研究主题的研究人员流向了人工智能领域，尤其是处于职业生涯中期的学者，同时审稿人的信心在5分制上整整下降了一分。从AlexNet到大语言模型，每一次连续的突破都提高了该领域对思想的承载能力，但随之而来的却是思想的加速枯竭。更大的突破捕获了……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于36年计算机科学数据发现，AI领域的每次重大突破（如AlexNet、Transformer、大语言模型）虽扩大了思想的承载容量，却吸引研究注意力急剧集中、多样性枯竭，因而越强的突破反而越快耗尽其自身赖以产生的思想资源。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 36 years of computer science research, this study shows that each stronger AI breakthrough raises the field's carrying capacity for ideas but is followed by steeper exhaustion, as collective attention narrows and diverse inquiry collapses into concentrated pursuit.
